listOfIntroStory.text: Once upon a time, amongst rolling green hills, there existed a prosperous kingdom named Magnarta.
It was a nation of noble heroes and fair maidens, as well as the home of the fabled Mystic Knights.
Old tales recount their sudden appearance, wielding steel and flame with unparalleled excellency.
After vanquishing all opposition, they formed a pact with the Magnartan rulers, ensuring a lasting peace to the lands.
Such legends inpired wonderment in folk's hearts, with many a youngster dreaming of becoming a Mystic Knight, fantasizing about great adventures.
One of those youngins was Maya, a girl of singular crimson hair, a reflection of her fiery spirit.
Her favorite pastime was to escape into the gardens, to play with wooden toys, determined to one day, transform her tenacious dream into reality.
Years come to pass, and Maya has grown to become a fine lady, still chasing her unique aspirations with great intent.
Duke Gamelon, her uncle, sought audience with the king, for the Duke held much steem in the court, and also loved his niece dearly.
The Duke's proposal: to allow his niece, Maya, to become a Mystic Knight.
Much discussion was had, and an impasse was reached. The Archbishop, leader of the chivalric order, had stern objections to the proposition.
The lords of the council thus decided to postpone their decision, given that the subject matter was of unprecedented nature.
'Blasphemy!', some councilmen barked, in the dimly lit room, in a dungeon somewhere, behind the King's back.
'Arrogance!', 'Sedition!', others parroted. Truthfully, they were all drunk on their own snobbery; this group of noblemen were corrupt from the start.
But archbishop Ivan was nefarious, and so he cooked an evil plot, to take advantage of this whole situation. He had the entire council under his control.
Days pass, and the council reconvenes, with a response to the Duke and his niece. A condition needed to be fulfilled, in order to grant their request.
A journey, to the remnants of an ancient empire, rumored to precede the Magnartan royal lineage.
On those forgotten lands, Maya would prove her valor, scouting the ruins to unearth a holy artifact, long lost, that would prove the imperial legitimacy of Magnarta.
The Duke objected to such perilous demand, but it fell on deaf ears, because his energetic niece readily accepted the quest.
Arrangements were made by the council. A merchant ship, on its way to trade in exotic lands, would carry Maya along, to then drop her near the uncharted destination.
Full of worry for his niece, the Duke decided to send someone to acompany Maya, someone he could trust.
Farina, the fairy-maid, who served his family for decades. She would be the ideal chaperone, a guide, and a voice of reason, to the stubborn red haired heroine.
And so it was, that for the better part of a week, the ship sailed, carrying under its frame, a hidden pair of maidens.
But when the voyage reached its 7th day, dusk brought about ill tidings on the horizon, as a swarm of colossal, dark clouds, stoically marched towards the ship.
Maya and Farina braced for the upcoming storm, praying for safety, but unsure, if the hurricane was merely a passing phenomenon, or a warning of much sinister things yet to come...
